definitions.gloss: non-urgent; not pressing; not immediately necessary
definitions.explanation: Describing something that does not require immediate attention or action. Almost always used in the pair {不要|ふよう}{不急|ふきゅう}.

examples.japanese: {不要|ふよう}{不急|ふきゅう}の{外出|がいしゅつ}を{控|ひか}える。
{不要|ふよう}{不急|ふきゅう}の{買|か}い{物|もの}はやめましょう。
{緊急|きんきゅう}{事態|じたい}{宣言|せんげん}{中|ちゅう}は、{不要|ふよう}{不急|ふきゅう}の{移動|いどう}を{自粛|じしゅく}するよう{呼|よ}びかけられた。
examples.english: During the state of emergency, people were urged to refrain from nonessential travel.

notes:
USAGE:
Rarely used alone; almost always appears in the four-character compound {不要|ふよう}{不急|ふきゅう} (nonessential and non-urgent). This phrase became widely known during the COVID-19 pandemic when the Japanese government repeatedly called on citizens to avoid {不要|ふよう}{不急|ふきゅう}の{外出|がいしゅつ}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {不要|ふよう}{不急|ふきゅう}の{外出|がいしゅつ} (nonessential outings)
- {不要|ふよう}{不急|ふきゅう}の{移動|いどう} (nonessential travel)
- {不要|ふよう}{不急|ふきゅう}の{用事|ようじ} (nonessential errands)
